lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the ONE home-dir / `~/.base-studio-code` resolver, so this CLI and
# the desktop app (`project/hub.rs`) agree on which projects dir they read/write; plus `now_ms()`,
# the one epoch-millis clock the `db` store stamps rows with.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): the byte-identical `main` wrapper (`cli_main`).
# Shared SQLite-CLI helpers (#1621): `default_store_path` + the app↔CLI busy_timeout `open_db`
# store (#2995) mirrors the plandb/compliance house pattern.
# The per-project plan store (#4052) — `progress` reads each hub's plan.db issue counts. Depended on
# for `is_done_status` so "done" has ONE definition on the Rust side rather than a third copy here.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store (#2158) — read-only here, to VALIDATE that a
# `project architect set` names a real persona whose role is `architect`. Depended on directly rather
# than via `bsc-persona` because that crate exposes only its CLI, no library API.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches src-tauri/plandb/compliance) for cross-platform reliability.
